characters.name: Ruby
characters.description: A cute white rabbit with long ears and a blue scarf

characters.name: Ellie
characters.description: A cheerful baby elephant with big round ears

characters.name: Pip
characters.description: A tiny yellow bird who is lost

scenes.description: A sunny forest. Ruby and Ellie find Pip crying on a branch.
scenes.narration: One sunny morning, Ruby and Ellie heard a tiny cry in the forest.

scenes.description: Ruby, Ellie and Pip walk across a flowery meadow.
scenes.narration: Do not worry, Pip! We will help you find your mother, said Ruby.

scenes.description: A big tree with a nest. Pip's mother hugs Pip.
scenes.narration: At the tallest tree, Pip found his mother. Everyone cheered happily!
